Anya Patel: Quick async — pulled llama3-smallq-v2 into the onboarding pipeline and ran the gated evals against promptset 'cardinality-ux-v1'. Overall pass but saw a ~3% drop on the 'tone' metric vs baseline. Artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/onboard/llama3-smallq-v2/1769871234. Logs + eval snippet below.

Sam Ortiz: can you paste the exact failing prompt/example? also did you run with kv-cache warm?

Anya Patel: here's a minimal failing prompt (sanitized): "Rewrite this message to be assertive but friendly: 'i think maybe we could consider...'". Ran with kv-cache warm (10 prefixes). Repro snippet: 
```
Baseline (v1): tone=0.92, acc=0.87
smallq-v2 : tone=0.89, acc=0.88
regression: tone -0.03
```

Kai Liu: interesting — accuracy up a bit but tone down. might be quantization shift or tokenizer split change. can you re-run `python eval/compare.py --metric=tone --limit=200 --no-quant`? also check batching/windowing config (we recently changed window_size from 128->96).

Anya Patel: on it — will run no-quant and a warm/no-warm kv comparison. timeline: run tonight (~4h) unless infra is busy.

Jose Fernandez: i'll take a quick look at PR #4821 (v2 tokenization tweaks). if we can't stabilise before the canary, i'd vote rollback to smallq-v1 for the canary route. :thinking_face:

ml-ci-bot: CI: eval-run-1769871234 completed SUCCESS. runtime=02:14:36. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-inference/onboard/llama3-smallq-v2/1769871234/eval.

Anya Patel: blockers: need a GPU slot for the extended no-quant run (estimated 3-5h). otherwise just isolating failing examples + PR review.

Kai Liu: created infra ticket INF-552 to reserve a dedicated GPU for the run tonight, linked the ticket to this thread. i'll also try swapping window_size back to 128 in a local test.

Sam Ortiz: thanks — ping me when you have the failing examples list, i'll add a targeted unit test to the promptset harness.

Anya Patel: will post the failing examples + raw tokens when the job finishes. tagging @Sam @Kai. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
